column1: # collisions.tsv — the routing ledger (the ONE central file of the context-routing test suite).
# Source of truth for routing is HYBRID: each skill/command/agent declares its own triggers + phase
# in its frontmatter; this file declares only the CROSS-skill facts that no single frontmatter can
# own — collision resolutions, orphan-by-design reach, and known dead-route defects. Consumed by
# scripts/verify-routing.sh. See docs/guide/routing-tests.md for the full pattern and how to extend.
# Format: 5 TAB-separated columns. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored.
#   collision   <family-id C0..C12>     comma-sep plugin:section that share intent  the disambiguating AXIS      human note
#   orphan      <plugin:section>        reach-kind: spawned-only|loop-only          who spawns it / how reached  why it has no user trigger (by design)
#   defect      <plugin:section>        the /command it claims but that is missing  DEAD-ROUTE                   tracked fix (backlog); WARN not FAIL until fixed
# kind=collision  → R4 asserts every member still exists and the signal is non-empty (a declared,
#                   resolvable collision is fine; an UNDECLARED exact-phrase collision FAILs).
# kind=orphan     → R1 treats the section as reachable-by-design (no user trigger required).
# kind=defect     → R3 downgrades this known missing command from FAIL to WARN, and it is listed as
#                   backlog. A NEW (unledgered) missing command FAILs hard.
# COLLISIONS — an intent/phrase claimed by more than one section. Resolved by an axis.
